saints.name: Our Lady of Guadalupe
saints.title: Patroness of the Americas
saints.shortBlurb: The Mother of God, appearing on the hill of Tepeyac and leaving her image on a poor man's cloak, drew a whole people to Christ…
biography: In December of 1531, ten years after the Spanish conquest of Mexico, the Blessed Virgin Mary appeared to the Indian convert St. Juan Diego on the hill of Tepeyac, speaking to him in his own tongue and asking that a church be built there. As a sign for the doubting bishop, she caused roses to bloom in winter and left upon Juan Diego's cloak the image venerated ever since as Our Lady of Guadalupe.

The apparition and the miraculous image drew millions of the native peoples to baptism. Our Lady of Guadalupe was declared Patroness of Mexico and of all the Americas, and her shrine in Mexico City is among the most visited in the world.
saints.knownFor: Her apparition at Tepeyac and the miraculous image on the tilma.
